title: Imperial Armored Commando
description: During the New Republic Era, these Imperial Commandos were loyal to Moff Gideon and the Imperial Shadow Council. Bearing jetpacks and beskar armor, they were much more formidable than an average Stormtrooper. The were also equipped with weapons more like a Mandalorian than a Stormtrooper, with flamethrowers, whipcord launchers, and vibro-knives—on top of their blaster rifles. When Bo-Katan Kryze and her united warriors arrived to take back Mandalore, they had to fight through these new commandos first.
